items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: it was-- we had a sergeant major in there, master sergeant, rather, by the name of Barry Ellis. He prevailed upon the colonel to just transfer me to the band.

ctx.x: Well, in the first place regimentation, you know, he couldn't go for that at all. This I knew. And he -- Lester was a very -- he was an introvert in a lot of ways, and a lot of people just wouldn't understand Lester. You know, they wouldn't understand him, and wouldn't know how to deal with him. Square. When I say a square I mean someone naturally out of the music business, wouldn't understand him. And they could -- and they could destroy a person, you know, like with me. When I went in the army and I had to go…
didn't understand the type of company I was in, which didn't mean too much to me any way because I assumed that they had a band and that I would be in the band.
